title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the government-cloud roadmap target from the Global rollout in Microsoft's notice. The current licensing guidance still supports its bulk-import licensing context, and the Azure role-assignment path and command are documented; searches found no feature-specific guidance that contradicts its stated gaps.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated an additional default beyond the administrator-driven workflow described.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Azure PST Import"'; read the roadmap and complete MC1455013, and opened Learn pst-import-overview and New-MigrationEndpoint. No separate automatic/default enablement is specified for this feature.

claims.claim: The existing Microsoft Purview portal PST import supports network upload.
claims.quote: Network upload: Upload the PST files over the network to a temporary Azure Storage location in the Microsoft cloud.

claims.claim: The existing Microsoft Purview portal PST import supports drive shipping.
claims.quote: Drive shipping: Copy the PST files to a BitLocker-encrypted hard drive and then physically ship the drive to Microsoft.

claims.claim: The documented existing method uses an import job in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.quote: Create a PST import job on the Import PST files page in the Microsoft Purview portal and submit the PST import mapping file you created in the previous step.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page for the new Azure PST Import feature was found at the time of writing in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Azure PST Import"' and '"Azure PST" "New-MigrationEndpoint" Analyze'; opened pst-import-overview and New-MigrationEndpoint. Results describe the existing portal workflow or other migration methods, not this new feature.

claims.claim: The notice does not name an Exchange or Purview administrator role required to run the cmdlets.
claims.quote: Searched: Read complete MC1455013 for roles and cmdlet permissions. It names administrator audiences and Storage Blob Data Reader, but no Exchange or Purview role for executing the feature's cmdlets.

claims.claim: Learn documents no cmdlet or parameter specifically for the new Azure PST Import workflow in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Azure PST Import" PowerShell roles cmdlets batch XML CSV'; '"New-MigrationBatch" "PST" "Analyze"'. Read New-MigrationEndpoint: -PSTImport is on-premises/internal only; batch search excerpts cover other migrations, not Azure PST Import.
